mentions.name: Listening Post
mentions.description: A macOS multi-scrobbler that works with Last.fm, ListenBrainz, Rocksky, Maloja, Shortcuts, and social posting, independent from Spotify or Apple Music. It can also scrobble Shazams (music recognitions) from iPhone and Apple Watch without needing an extra app.
mentions.source_excerpt: Listening Post is my macOS multi-scrobbler that works with Last.fm, ListenBrainz, Rocksky, Maloja, Shortcuts, social posting, etc., independent from Spotify or Apple Music. The app can also scrobble shazams (music recognitions) from iPhone and Apple Watch, without the need for an extra app.
